# FLX-3612: a consumers calibration declaration is malformed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

calibration declares at most 64 parameters, each with a document, an RFC 6901 pointer, an exact decimal min below max and a step above zero; evaluations from 1 to 4,096 (64 when absent); scale in (0, 1] (1 when absent); heldOutTolerance, an exact decimal from 0 to 1; and a seed, a whole number. Only the shape is read here: nothing is fitted.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3612
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
